## Purpose
Keeps dependencies, build outputs, framework caches, env files and logs out of the frontend image's build context.

## Settings that matter
node_modules, .output, dist, .nitro, .tanstack, .wrangler, .vinxi, .env, `.env.*`, `*.log`, Dockerfile, .dockerignore.

## Read by
Docker, when building `frontend-3/Dockerfile`.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
`.env` files never reach the image. Build-time `VITE_*` values would have to be passed another way.

## How to rebuild this file
List the patterns above.
